invariants.rationale: The method iterates over 'orders', so it must not be null at exit.
Method throws if any order is null, so all elements must be non-null.
The method throws if any order has quantity <= 0, so all must be strictly positive.
The method throws if any order has a negative unit price, so all must be non-negative.
A List always has a non-negative size; included for completeness.
